info.title: KoboFX API
info.description:
The KoboFX FX trading API (v1). Conventions every client must follow:

- **Amounts are strings of minor units**, never JSON numbers: `"150000"` NGN is ₦1,500.00. The scale of a currency is
  its `minorUnit` (NGN 2, USD 2, JPY 0, KWD 3), returned next to every amount. Rates are display strings; the amounts
  are authoritative.
- **`Idempotency-Key` is required on every mutating money and admin route** (16–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`;
  one key per logical operation, reused on every retry of it). Keys never expire. A replay answers the stored response
  byte for byte with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`.
  Transient failures (`503`, `500`, `429`, `409 REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`) store nothing: retry with the SAME key.
  `/auth/*` takes no key.
- **Errors** always have the `ErrorResponse` shape. Branch on `code` (stable, never renamed), never on `message`.
  Each operation lists only the codes it can raise. `Retry-After` accompanies `429`, `503` and
  `409 REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS`.
- **`X-Correlation-Id`**: send your own (8–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`) or receive a generated UUID; it is on every
  response and in every error body.
- **Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (RS256 JWT, short-lived: 15 minutes by default) on everything that is not marked
  public. Most routes also require an ACTIVE (verified, not suspended) user. Refresh tokens rotate strictly: a reused
  refresh token revokes the whole session family, so single-flight your refreshes.
- **Rate limits**: 100 requests per minute per IP on every route (except health), plus the per-route limits listed on
  each operation.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error codes: clients branch on these. A code is never renamed or reused.

- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400): The request is malformed. A body/query DTO failure lists `details.violations`; fix the request.
- `INVALID_AMOUNT` (400): The amount is not a positive whole number of minor units in range.
- `UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY` (400): The currency is not supported for this operation.
- `SAME_CURRENCY` (400): `from` and `to` are the same currency.
- `UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY_PAIR` (400): The directional pair is not offered (or not active).
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` (400): This route needs an `Idempotency-Key` header.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID` (400): `Idempotency-Key` must be 16–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`.
- `INVALID_CURSOR` (400): The cursor is malformed, from another version, or from a different sort/filter set. Restart from the first page.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): No valid credentials: missing/expired/revoked access token, a refused refresh token, or a bad webhook signature.
- `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (401): Login refused. Deliberately the same for an unknown email, a wrong password, an unverified or a suspended account.
- `VERIFICATION_FAILED` (400): The email, password and one-time password do not verify an account awaiting verification.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): Authenticated, but your role may not do this.
- `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` (403): The account is suspended.
- `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (403): Verify the email address first.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): No such route or resource.
- `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such ledger account.
- `RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such reservation.
- `FUNDING_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such funding for this user (unknown and another user's are the same answer).
- `QUOTE_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such quote for this user (unknown and another user's are the same answer).
- `TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such transaction for this user (unknown and another user's are the same answer).
- `RECONCILIATION_BREAK_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such reconciliation break.
- `APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such approval.
- `USER_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such user.
- `RECONCILIATION_RUN_NOT_FOUND` (404): No such reconciliation run.
- `SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN` (403): Four-eyes: you may not decide (or review) your own request.
- `BREAK_GLASS_NOT_ALLOWED` (403): Break-glass is only for SUSPEND_USER and RATE_OVERRIDE (MANUAL_RATE).
- `INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS` (409): The available balance does not cover it, even counting held funds: top up.
- `FUNDS_RESERVED` (409): The total balance would cover it but part is held by a pending operation: wait for it.
- `QUOTE_EXPIRED` (409): The quote's 30 seconds are over. Request a new quote.
- `QUOTE_ALREADY_USED` (409): Quotes are single-use and this one was executed.
- `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` (409): This key was used with a different request body on this route. Use a new key.
- `REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS` (409): The same key is being processed right now. Retry after `Retry-After` with the same key.
- `PERIOD_LOCKED` (409): The value time falls in a closed reporting period.
- `ALREADY_CORRECTED` (409): The original transaction was already corrected.
- `RESERVATION_NOT_ACTIVE` (409): The reservation is no longer active.
- `RESERVATION_CONFLICT` (409): The reservation exists with different terms.
- `PRICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (409): The priced amounts breach `minimumTargetAmount` / `maximumSourceAmount`; `details` has the priced amounts.
- `RECONCILIATION_RUN_LEASE_LOST` (409): Internal: a reconciliation run lost its lease.
- `APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED` (409): The approval is no longer PENDING (or is a break-glass use, which is never decided).
- `APPROVAL_EXPIRED` (409): The approval passed its time to live without a decision.
- `APPROVAL_REQUESTER_INELIGIBLE` (409): The requester no longer holds the role (or is no longer active).
- `BREAK_GLASS_ALREADY_REVIEWED` (409): This break-glass use was already reviewed (or is not a break-glass use).
- `ACTION_PRECONDITION_FAILED` (409): The world does not allow this action now (see `details`).
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413): The body exceeds 100 KB.
- `AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL` (422): Below the minimum for this currency or pair.
- `AMOUNT_TOO_LARGE` (422): Above the per-operation maximum.
- `DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (422): The rolling 24-hour limit for this source currency would be exceeded.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): Too many requests. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.
- `RESOURCE_BUSY` (503): Transient lock or statement timeout. Retry with the SAME `Idempotency-Key`.
- `FX_RATE_STALE` (503): No executable rate right now (rates may still be displayed). Transient: retry later with the same key.
- `FX_RATE_UNAVAILABLE` (503): No rate can be served at all. Transient.
- `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` (503): A dependency we cannot work without is down; we fail closed. Transient.
- `INVARIANT_VIOLATION` (500): Our bug, failed loudly. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `LEDGER_UNBALANCED` (500): Our bug: a posting did not balance. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `INVALID_POSTING` (500): Our bug: an invalid posting was refused. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH` (500): Our bug: an entry's currency differs from its account's. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `REVERSAL_MISMATCH` (500): Our bug: a reversal did not mirror its original. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `INVALID_RESERVATION` (500): Our bug: an invalid reservation settlement. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500): Unexpected error. Quote the `correlationId`.
- `HTTP_ERROR` (400): An HTTP-level refusal without a dedicated code.
